name: Ninagawa Sakura
source:
[b]S-Rank Landlady[/b]

Occupation: Dormitory Manager
Height: Average
Breast Size: Slightly smaller than others but still large

The landlady of Yuunagi-sou boasts "S-Rank Management Skills," according to her own claims. Although the building itself is pretty aged, her peerless organizational prowess keeps every nook and cranny, garden included, in impeccable condition.

Initially content with simply maintaining her inn, the manager could not deny harboring a secret yearning... to apply her managerial talents to a man.

When the protagonist arrived seeking lodgings, laying eyes on him stoked those clandestine desires as never before.

「 The truth is, I want to manage...you (a man).」
